THIRD-PARTY LICENSES — scripts/prover-bench/dist/bench.js
=========================================================

bench.js is an esbuild bundle. It INLINES the third-party packages listed
below, so their copyright and permission notices travel with it, as MIT and
Zlib require. The package list was derived from the `sources` array of the
sibling bench.js.map, and every text below was copied verbatim from the
package's own LICENSE file (or, where the npm package ships none, from the
license the package declares in its package.json).

Bundled packages:
  @noble/curves          1.9.7          MIT
  @noble/hashes          1.8.0          MIT
  @noir-lang/acvm_js     1.0.0-beta.9   MIT
  @noir-lang/noir_js     1.0.0-beta.9   MIT OR Apache-2.0  (MIT taken)
  @noir-lang/noirc_abi   1.0.0-beta.9   MIT OR Apache-2.0  (MIT taken)
  @zkpassport/poseidon2  0.6.2          MIT
  pako                   2.1.0          MIT AND Zlib

Also inlined: TypeScript sources from the stellar-confidential-token-demo SDK
(github.com/brozorec/stellar-confidential-token-demo @ ac67499, MIT — that
repository ships no LICENSE file; the license is declared in its package.json).

NOT bundled: @aztec/bb.js (loaded as native ESM at runtime).

See ../../../NOTICE.md for the full attribution picture.
